column1: # Pinned PPC reference toolchain packages: filename, deb architecture,
# sha256, immutable Launchpad archive URL. Every host (noble CI runner,
# newer-Ubuntu dev machines, the containerized macOS path) extracts these
# exact bytes, so the reference compiler, binutils, and qemu are identical
# to the certified linux gate host regardless of what the local apt
# archive currently carries. Versions were recorded from the noble
# (24.04) runner archive on 2026-08-05; bump deliberately, re-recording
# hashes, since PPC codegen identity is part of the suite identities.
# Rows with arch "all" apply to every host; "amd64"/"arm64" rows follow
# host_arch.sh (Apple Silicon populates the arm64 tree).
